# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and WASM .NET 11** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships Skia m151, broad managed performance improvements, and WASM support for .NET 11. This release ports several hot-path operations to managed C# to eliminate P/Invoke round-trips, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for the upcoming .NET 11 WASM runtime, and brings in upstream Skia m151 engine bug fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, picking up upstream bug fixes and GPU stability improvements. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))
- **Upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs merged** — Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes are cherry-picked into the release line, including a CPU raster regression fix for SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT. ([#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now accept ReadOnlySpan<char>, avoiding string allocations in hot paths that parse color strings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **Performance: hot-path operations ported to managed C#** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKFourByteTag.Parse, SKShaper glyph reads via zero-copy spans, and HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 are now managed implementations, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these frequently-called paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))
- **GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed** — The unnecessary unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions has been removed, making the type easier to use in safe contexts. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData with crop rect** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) leaked a native resource when the crop rect was provided. The handle is now correctly released. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **WASM .NET 11 support: Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception-handling model are included for .NET 11 WASM targets. A preview-.NET WASM test job is also added to catch exception-handling regressions early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free using pooled UTF-8 encoding, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse eliminates the per-call char[4] allocation.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

RC 1 merged the final upstream m151 bug-fix syncs, the WASM .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries, and the CPU raster regression fix. This was the final pre-release before stable 4.151.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)
